svg.title: PathSG system architecture diagram
svg.desc: Client-server, 3-layered architecture of the PathSG school information system: Vue 3 single page app in the browser, nginx web server, FastAPI application server with a SQLite database, and the OpenAI and data.gov.sg external systems.
svg.text: Architecture = {Components, Connectors} · Client–Server style with a 3-layered structure (Presentation · Application Logic · Persistent Data)
createApp · createPinia · restore the saved session
→ install router + guards → mount the app
thin: validate → call model / core → respond
main.py: load .env · register CORS, routers and the error handler
Design rationale – how the architecture was derived (Lecture 12: requirements → principles → patterns → constraints)
UC-5 Admin data update and export
PERF search, profile ≤ 2 s · AI plan ≤ 15 s
REL all-or-nothing data refresh · health checks
PORT Docker images for amd64 and arm64
Modularity: router + store + service per feature
Low coupling: view → store → service, one way
Single responsibility: thin routers, rules in models
Reuse: shared UI components, HttpError enums
Strategy: rule-based vs AI roadmap generator
Data: SQLite, a single server instance
External: OpenAI API · no live map API
use the app in a browser
